question: Can a complete Boolean SAT solver find and independently verify a decomposition on the frozen n=17 planted and ordinary-query systems within a 180-second per-arm cap?
method: Reuse frozen builder; Tseitin CNF with shared monomial AND gates and four-clause XOR gates; solve one witness per arm; verify witness against original Boolean equations and exact V^3 enumeration
host: local macOS, one Sage producer and one SAT process at a time; algorithmic diagnostic tier
checks: source and solver hashes, planted residual zero, exact V^3 enumeration, witness replay through original equations; preserve timeout, crash, and zero-solution states
claim_boundary: stage-level first-witness result on two deterministic n=17 inputs; does not measure full relation yield, n=131 cost, or single-target end-to-end time
